def: The simple method or current practice whose score every more elaborate method has to beat.
Sampling parameter settings at random and keeping the best, a strong control for fancier search.
Changing one candidate a little and keeping the change only if the score does not get worse.
Evaluating a new rule by re-running logged past cases through it.
A model of a process used to score candidate policies when replay cannot show what would have happened.
Running a new version alongside the current one without acting on its output.
Serving a new version to a small share of real traffic with automatic rollback if guardrails move.
The gradual change of live data away from the data a search or model was tuned on.
